procedural_matters: NED 221858 was represented by Alexsander Hartsink.
ESP 225111 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 15 kts of wind and 40 cm waves.
Both boats on port tack overlapped, with NED 221858 to windward of ESP 225111 approaching mark 1 above lay- line.
At a distance of 1,5 boat length from mark 1, NED 221858 passed head to wind.
After NED 221858 reached close-hauled course, ESP 225111 passed head to wind.
Before ESP 225111 reached close-hauled course, there was contact between ESP 225111 bow port side and NED 221858 aft starboard quarter.
conclusions: After passing head to wind and before being on a close-hauled course, ESP 225111 failed to keep clear of NED
ESP 225111 did not avoid contact with NED 221858 when it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for NED 221858, the right-of-way boat, to avoid contact with ESP 225111 when it became clear that ESP 225111 was not keeping clear. NED 221858 did not break RRS 14(a).
